messages:
tariq: Heads-up: field requests from two pilot customers asking that we never reassign their customer-owned CIDRs during private deploy upgrades. They want an explicit "no-rebind" mode in the installer. Need quick product/tech decision.

hana: Can we offer this as an opt-in upgrade lane? i.e., standard fast path (best-effort rebind) vs. strict "no-rebind" lane that requires operator coordination.

jules: Technical constraints: to guarantee no rebind we must persist network allocation metadata outside ephemeral nodes (PV or external KV) and avoid any cloud IP reclaim flows. That blocks some autoscaling and node replacement patterns.

marco: For on-prem there's also BGP sessions to preserve. If we drain/control-plane replace we lose established adjacencies unless we persist peer keys + session IPs and push a migration update to routers.

tariq: Example request from BetaCorp: they provided this snippet and expect the installer to honor it:
```yaml
upgrade:
  network_mode: no_rebind
  reserved_cidrs: [172.16.50.0/24]
  preserve_peers: true
  offline_upgrade: true
```

hana: UX/field concerns: customers want a simple toggle in the console/installer: "Preserve customer network (may increase upgrade time)" and a short explainer with tradeoffs. Also telemetry opt-in so we can confirm success.

jules: Proposal for implementation: 1) add flag `--no-rebind` to installer; 2) store network allocations in a cluster-scoped PV or configured external KV (Vault/Consul); 3) add a migration step that injects preserved peer IPs and certs back after upgrade.

marco: Must also add a preflight that validates reserved_cidrs don't overlap with cluster defaults. Sample command we could run in preflight:
```
redwoodctl preflight --check-network --reserved 172.16.50.0/24
```
Preflight should fail with clear remediation steps.

hana: Launch criteria idea: (A) installer honors reserved_cidrs and exposes toggle; (B) migration job exists and documented; (C) two pilots (BetaCorp + one more) complete; (D) runbook and rollback doc in docs repo.

tariq: SLA notes: for "no-rebind" lane we should set expectation that upgrades can take longer and may require a 15-30 minute operator window. For standard lane keep existing SLOs.

jules: Edge case: what if reserved_cidrs were assigned but later needed for scaling? we should add a reclaim policy where operator approval required to release. Also audit logs for reserved ranges.

hana: Field asks: (1) turnkey telemetry snippet customers can drop into their privacy policy; (2) sample playbook for airgapped/manual upgrades.

ops-bot: reminder: Pilot slot open next Thu 2026-05-21 14:00 UTC. Reply with +1 to claim.

marco: Action items: Jules -> draft PR for `--no-rebind` storage + migration flow (owner: jules, due: Fri). Hana -> UI copy + telemetry opt-in language (owner: hana, due: Tue). Tariq -> consolidate launch criteria and operator SLAs (owner: tariq, due: Wed).

tariq: Thanks team. We'll track pilot outcomes before freezing this as a gated requirement for Private GA. If pilots show automation gaps, we'll ship as opt-in alpha first. :white_check_mark:
